thread.title: Here’s How Much The FANG+ Stocks Gained In 2017; Is There More Room To Run? – Financial News USA

author: Andre T
title: Here’s How Much The FANG+ Stocks Gained In 2017; Is There More Room To Run? – Financial News USA
text:
by Andre T · January 1, 2018 
The Nasdaq surged 28% in 2017 as big-name tech stocks continued to show their dominance. How well did the FANG+ stocks perform, and could there be more room for them to run in 2018? Here’s the scorecard for Facebook (FB), Amazon (AMZN), Netflix (NFLX), Google parent Alphabet (GOOGL) and Apple (AAPL). Facebook 
X Facebook gained 53% in 2017. The stock last broke out of a base in October, and has seen somewhat sluggish, sideways action since then. Facebook shares remain within the 5% buy range of that 175.59 entry but have lost support at the key 50-day line. 
Facebook also has a new flat base with a 184.35 buy point. Investors may want to focus on that entry now. Amazon 
Amazon shares increased 56% in 2017, and the stock could soon present a fresh buying opportunity. After Friday’s close, the stock has now completed five weeks of base building, which is the minimum amount of time it takes for a base to form. The new buy point is at 1,213.51. But this is a late-stage base, meaning it has higher odds of failing.

Netflix rose 55% for the year, and has built several bases along its run. Shares closed Friday back below their 50-day line as they try to build the right side of a base with a 204.48 entry. Alphabet 
Google parent Alphabet climbed the least of its FANG+ peers, at 33% for the year. After hitting an all-time high of 1,086.49 on Dec. 18, shares have been steadily slipping, pushing the stock back into buy range. The last entry point for Alphabet was at 1,006.29. Apple 
Apple gained 46% for the year. Apple’s recent breakout over a 176.34 flat base buy point has been met with resistance, and shares lost support at the 50-day line Friday. A further decline could trigger a sell signal, while convincing support at the 50-day line would be a positive indicator.
